# roblog

Are you preparing a blog post or tech note for rOpenSci, after getting
the go-ahead and a tentative publication date from our community
manager? Stay here! The goal of roblog is to provide practical helpers
for authors of blog posts and tech notes on rOpenSci website.

Best paired with [rOpenSci blog
guidance](https://blogguide.ropensci.org/).

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropenscilabs/roblog")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ro_blog_post_author()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/roblog/reference/blog-posts.md)
  : Create a new rOpenSci author file
- [`create_newsletter_content()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/roblog/reference/create_newsletter_content.md)
  : Create newsletter content for Sendgrid
- [`ro_check_urls()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/roblog/reference/ro_check_urls.md)
  : Check URLs in Markdown post
- [`ro_lint_md()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/roblog/reference/ro_lint_md.md)
  : Lint Markdown post for rOpenSci blog
